faqSection.title: Enterprise FAQ
faqSection.description: Common questions about Enterprise plans, security, and onboarding.

items.question: When should I discuss an enterprise pilot?
items.answer: When you run several stores or brands, have thousands of products, need a security review, or want a pilot with targets agreed in writing.

items.question: How does a pilot start?
items.answer: Start with one market and one category on public data. Agree the scope, fees and collection method before work begins.

items.question: Is SOC 2 available today?
items.answer: No. A certification or completed audit is not available today. Discuss your security requirements before agreeing a pilot.

items.question: Can we export dashboard results through the API?
items.answer: Not today. The public REST API, MCP server and CLI support discovery, plans, connection and onboarding workflows.
